rule: This audit deletes nothing. Every disposition is a forward-looking recommendation for a later, separately-authorized packaging phase.

components.reason: Micro-scale fluency only; no retrieval; decorative; strictly weaker special case of modern delta-rule family; no kernel path. Binding directive.
Frozen canonical Phase reference; keep for reproducibility of prior reports, not for the package.
Phase-dependent; default decode is full-prefix replay; no checkpoints. Replaced by KDA-MLA hybrid.
Phase write-side; superseded by delta-rule state.
Materializes N×N before Top-K (O(N^2)); 'O(nk)' claim false; the exact-retrieval role is filled by periodic MLA instead.
Two N×N ops/layer; no KV cache; full-prefix replay decode; Phase-dependent.
Ontological + Phase-dependent; not validated.
Only impl with source/version/supersession/eviction; fragile single-fact recall (1/3 seeds). Independent of Phase. May enter package only after multi-seed thresholds. Backbone must not depend on it.
Bounded but soft-EMA-only; no deletion/version/source. If slots are adopted, reimplement on the clean BoundedBindingSlots contract.
Materializes N×N despite O(n*w) docstring. Replace with SWA/MLA from the modern stack.
Correct O(N*W) reference; useful as a baseline, not the canonical path (KDA already bounded).
Separate O(n^2)+gating architecture, misleadingly co-located; no matched evidence; out of scope for the recurrent-hybrid package.
Phase-free evidence-typed dual-attention experiment; event path promising (+0.63) but interaction marginal; RM1 real-model RESOURCE_BLOCKED. Keep as research; not a model-core component.
Not a model architecture; a small->frontier handover scaffold + SEEB benchmark. Belongs to a different capability boundary; keep separate from the Hybrid LLM model core.
Routes to internal 7B sub-models; not the sequence-mixer package.
Governance/steering layer; not a model.
Provider-selection governance engine; must not be merged with Hybrid LLM (#9).
Dispatcher trainer (defaults to ontological, not Phase). The vNext core needs a fresh, scoped training harness on the FLA/KDA stack; keep the old one for legacy repro.
Phase/GCT training recipes; no verified checkpoints; keep for reproducibility.
Falsification harnesses; clean, valuable as matched-baseline references for the vNext experiment; not shipped.
Micro-scale/self-reported; retain for provenance; the A100 30x figure is a computed (not run) baseline.
SUPERSEDED by v3; over-generalized synthetic probes into product claims.
Already converged on the skeptical reading; keep as the canonical historical record. One migration note may state Phase was evaluated and excluded.
Documentation tests (string presence, marketing arithmetic); must never be cited as model evidence; do not carry into the package as 'validation'.
